title: No role commits a merge whose conflicts span test and non-test files
why: Coordinator, 13:51 CST Nov 7: filed as a step, not a note.
note: Sighting (lane commit-refuses-conflict-markers, session_013NEJKzXJPDWrSRe3i1fGJd, 22:12 CST Nov 8): merging main e0b9696ca into #2083 conflicts in hooks/guard_merge.py (import union) and hooks/test_guard.py (two loops); the builder was refused the test hunk and the test-author declined the product hunk. Workaround: a test-author moves the branch's test loop first, so the merge conflicts only in product code, then a builder merges. Same gap as steps merge-conflict-mixed-roles and mixed-merge-resolver. Clean-merge case filed on step merge-conflict-mixed-roles (#2313), 22:41 CST Nov 8; #1521 should cover it. Sighting (lane time-from-one-helper, 15:45 CST Nov 9, with #1521 on main 624dcc188 and current hooks, merge_route_paths count 3): in a merge of origin/main into #2264, a test-author's Edit of the conflicted .github/workflows/checks.yml was refused twice by test-author-scope ("No override lifts this refusal"), while the same merge's conflicts in guard.py, guard_merge.py and test_guard.py were writable. So the mixed-merge route does not cover a conflicted workflow file at the write tool. Fix: the route's path set covers CI config conflicts, or names who resolves them. Sighting (coordinator 19:36 CST Nov 9, helper session_013NEJL4J7jxH2NTeETZEdne, #2022): the mixed-merge route (item 420 a) lets a test-author commit a merge, but test-author-scope refuses its edit of a doc or product hunk, with no override (decision builders-cannot-edit-tests). Workaround: a record-writer makes a docs-only pre-resolve commit before the test-author merges. Fix: the route names that order, or the scope allows a merge-resolution hunk. Same class as the workflow-file sighting above; related: merge-route-author-paths.
